subject_rule: Limited to what the participating universities offer: the Bolashak Centre says the list of participating universities and the available fields of study is shown on the Study In portal during the application process, and the Ministry reports that 27 universities offered 886 educational programmes in the 2026 competition.
notes: No programmes recorded (0 per level). The official list of the 886 programmes exists only inside the Study In admission portal, which is a JavaScript-only single-page application with applicant sign-in (the list is shown inside the application flow, not as a public document), and applications closed on 31 May 2026; no PDF, Excel or public HTML version of the list was found on the Bolashak Centre, Ministry of Science and Higher Education, Ministry of Education or Study In sites.
The only stated programme count is 886 programmes at 27 universities (Ministry news of 31 July 2026, for the 2026-2027 awards). The 2025 university list names 37 universities.

Astana IT University names seven schools for its applicants (Intelligent Systems; AI and Data Science; Software Engineering; Cybersecurity; Creative Industries; General Education Disciplines; Digital Public Administration), which is a university page, not the scholarship's programme list, so it is not recorded as programmes.
not_stated: Any list of specialties or educational programmes outside the login-based portal
Whether any subject is allowed (the sources say only that available fields are shown on the portal)
fetch_problems: The Study In admission portal is a JavaScript-only application with sign-in; its list of universities and programmes is shown inside the application flow and was not bypassed.
The Study In home page returned 502 Bad Gateway when requested.
